title: Madrid daily noise measurements (Linked Data)

label: Madrid hospitality terraces (Linked Data)
title: Madrid hospitality terraces (Linked Data)
description: RDF adaptation of the selected 6,594-row terraces census snapshot with source load date 2026-10-04. Eligible premises or grouping entrance coordinates are transformed from EPSG:25830 to EPSG:4326 as location proxies; unavailable locations are omitted. This snapshot does not establish a terrace's existence on every historical noise date. Contains data from the Ayuntamiento de Madrid (datos.madrid.es), CC BY 4.0; converted to RDF by ODKG 2026-2027 Group03.
